It runs locally as a CLI and as an MCP server. It calls public package registry and OSV APIs directly; there is no hosted deptrust service. I built this because AI coding agents kept suggesting outdated or vulnerable package versions. items.title: 物理 AI 到来，移动网络该如何进化？
items.raw_excerpt: 过去一年，几乎所有人都在追问同一个问题： AI 大模型还能变得多聪明？Agent、多模态、端侧部署，构成了 AI 产业最热闹的叙事。 但当 AI 开始进入眼镜、汽车、机器人、摄像头这些物理载体，开始在道路、工厂、家庭和人类交互之后，我们发现，现实世界和 AI 大模型之间，还有最后一公里的路没有打通。 AI 眼镜要识别眼前的文字，Robotaxi 要判断周围路况，机器人要决定下一步动作。它们依赖的不只是算法，也包括图像、语音、位置、空间关系、设备状态和环境变化等数据。 这些数据需要先由终端采集，再通过网络上传，交给云端或边缘侧模型处理。模型输出的结果，也要通过网络返回终端，才能转化现实中的业务动作。 这使得移动网络在 AI 时代承担了新的压力。 过去，网络波动可能只是让视频缓冲几秒；未来，同样的波动可能导致实时识别失败、远程控制迟滞，或者智能体无法完成动作。 移动网络不再只是单纯的内容分发通道。它需要识别连接对象，理解业务类型，判断实时性要求，也要在资源紧张时决定哪些连接需要优先保障。 物理 AI 时代的网络，不能只是一条“更宽的管道”。 移动网络的下一批用户，不只是人类 很长一段时间里，移动通信网络服务的核心对象是人。 在语音时代，网络解决的是通话连接，让人在移动状态下完成实时沟通。进入 3G、4G 时代后，智能手机和在线内容快速普及，移动网络的主要任务转向大带宽数据传输。网页、图片、音乐、视频、直播、游戏和在线会议，成为了移动互联网时代最典型的业务形态。 智能手机也在这个过程中变成了高度集成的入口。过去由独立设备完成的功能，例如 GPS、音乐播放器、相机、录音机和部分办公工具，逐渐被手机吸收到一个终端里。移动互联网时代的一个基本特征，是终端形态向手机集中，人则是最主要的连接主体。 AI 的到来改变了这个前提。 大模型要理解现实世界，首先需要获得更丰富、更连续的现实输入。图

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, almost everyone has been asking the same question: How much smarter can large AI models become? Agents, multimodality, and edge deployment have formed the most compelling narrative in the AI industry. But as AI begins to enter physical carriers such as glasses, cars, robots, and cameras, and starts interacting with humans on roads, in factories, and at home, we have discovered that there is still a last mile to bridge between the real world and large AI models. AI glasses need to recognize text in sight, Robotaxis must assess surrounding road conditions, and robots have to decide their next move. They rely not only on algorithms but also on data such as images, speech, location, spatial relationships, device status, and environmental changes. This data must first be collected by terminals, then uploaded via the network to cloud or edge models for processing. The model output must also be returned through the network to the terminal to translate into real-world operational actions. This places new pressure on mobile networks in the AI era. In the past, network fluctuations might only cause a few seconds of video buffering; in the future, the same fluctuations could lead to real-time recognition failures, delayed remote control, or agents being unable to complete actions. Mobile networks are no longer just a channel for content distribution. They need to identify connected objects, understand business types, assess real-time requirements, and decide which connections should be prioritized when resources are scarce. The network in the era of physical AI cannot simply be a "wider pipe." The next batch of mobile network users will not just be humans.
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, casi todo el mundo se hacía la misma pregunta: ¿cuánto más inteligentes pueden llegar a ser los grandes modelos de IA? Los agentes, la multimodalidad y la implementación en dispositivos periféricos conforman la narrativa más vibrante de la industria de la IA. Sin embargo, cuando la IA comienza a integrarse en gafas, coches, robots, cámaras y otros soportes físicos, y a interactuar con humanos en carreteras, fábricas y hogares, descubrimos que aún falta un último kilómetro por recorrer entre el mundo real y los grandes modelos de IA. Las gafas de IA deben reconocer el texto que tienen delante, los Robotaxi deben evaluar el tráfico circundante y los robots deben decidir su próximo movimiento. Lo que necesitan no es solo algoritmos, sino también imagen, voz, posición y relaciones espaciales.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 雷峰网讯 过去一周，AI 开发者圈讨论的焦点，已经不只是谁又发布了更强的模型，而是一个更现实的问题， 谁还能稳定地调用到最强的模型？ 随着美国对于 Fable 5 调用的限制，顶级闭源模型的可获得性终于成为了悬在开发者头上的不确定因素。特别是对于已经把大模型深度接入代码生成、Agent 工作流和企业应用的团队来说，一个模型哪怕性能再强，只要存在访问受限、策略调整、价格波动或突然下架的风险，就跟“可靠的基础设施”不沾边了。 OpenRouter 给出了一种解法，即不要押注单一最佳模型，而是通过多模型协作和模型路由，在不同任务之间动态切换能力最合适的模型。这代表了应用层的一种新趋势，当最强模型不可控时，开发者开始追求可替代、可组合、可持续的模型系统。 就在这个背景下，6 月 17 日 GLM-5.2 的发布格外触动神经。 硅谷最顶级的风投机构之 一 a16z 的联合创始人 Marc Andreessen 在 十天后 于 X 上发文称，「许多聪明人和 AI 圈内人认为，GLM-5.2 是第一个能够无妥协地匹敌、甚至超越美国大实验室公开模型的中国 AI」，并特别点出：「时机妙极，恰逢当下。」 这句评价更重要的意义 或许在于，他转述的，正是硅谷圈子里正在形成的共识—开源的中国模型，在能力上做到了和美国顶级实验室同台竞技。 根据智谱 AI 官方文档，GLM-5.2 整体表现介于 Claude Opus 4.7 与 Opus 4.8 之间，在 FrontierSWE 等长程编程任务上表现尤其突出，仅落后 Opus 4.8 约 1%，同时超过 GPT-5.5 和 Opus 4.7。 另有社区讨论也将其视为目前开源模型阵营中，最接近顶级闭源模型的一次跃迁。马斯克预测智谱大模型大约在 2027 年 Q1 达到 Fable 5，唐杰本人亲自下场回复：用不了那么久。 在一个顶级模型供给越来越不稳定
excerpt_i18n.en: Leiphone News Over the past week, the focus of AI developer discussions has shifted from who released a stronger model to a more practical issue: who can still reliably call the strongest model? With US restrictions on calling Fable 5, the availability of top closed-source models has finally become an uncertain factor hanging over developers. Especially for teams that have deeply integrated large models into code generation, Agent workflows, and enterprise applications, even the most powerful model is not considered "reliable infrastructure" as long as there is a risk of access restrictions, policy adjustments, price fluctuations, or sudden removal. OpenRouter offers a solution: instead of betting on a single best model, dynamically switch between the most suitable models for different tasks through multi-model collaboration and model routing. This represents a new trend in the application layer: when the strongest models become uncontrollable, developers begin to pursue replaceable, composable, and sustainable model systems. Against this backdrop, the release of GLM-5.2 on June 17 struck a chord. Ten days later, Marc Andreessen, co-founder of a16z, one of Silicon Valley's top venture capital firms, posted on X saying, "Many smart people and AI insiders believe that GLM-5.2 is the first Chinese AI that can match or even surpass public models from US labs without compromise," and specifically noted: "The timing is perfect, coinciding with the current moment."

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News - It’s hard to treat coding as just one of the many capability dimensions of large models. Compared with plain text or image generation, clearer rules, strict syntax, and verifiable results are only part of the reason. What’s more special is that on the evolutionary chain from chatbot to agent, coding – which involves tool invocation, data processing, and complex workflow automation – carries most of the expectations for a model to move from “talking” to “doing.” A noteworthy shift is that coding is emerging from a dazzling array of benchmark lists to become an infrastructure-level metric for model competition. Whether from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or other players, nearly every new model launch features coding scenarios as a show of strength. In a sense, this is an emerging industry consensus: coding ability not only represents programming skill but is also a key measure of a model’s logical reasoning, tool usage, and practical productivity. We’re also curious how far domestic models have evolved in this fiercely competitive coding arena. To find out, we selected five Chinese models known for their programming capabilities – DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2.6, Qwen 3.7 Max, GLM 5.1, and MiniMax M3 – and put them through a real engineering task.
excerpt_i18n.es: Noticias de Leifeng. Es difícil considerar Coding simplemente como una de las muchas dimensiones de capacidad de los grandes modelos. En comparación con la generación de texto o imágenes, las reglas más claras, la sintaxis estricta y los resultados verificables del código son solo parte de la razón. Lo más especial es que, en la cadena evolutiva de ChatBot a Agent, Coding implica llamadas a herramientas, procesamiento de datos y automatización de flujos complejos, y casi carga con la mayoría de las expectativas de que el modelo pase de "saber hablar" a "saber hacer". Un cambio digno de atención es que Coding está destacando entre los deslumbrantes listados de Benchmark, convirtiéndose en una competencia de modelos.

items.title: 文生图开源第一易主，但 HiDream-O1-Image 为什么褒贬不一？
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网讯 2026 年 5 月，智象未来开源了文生图模型 HiDream-O1-Image（8B），直接登顶 Artificial Analysis 开源模型全球第一，Elo 1187 的分数力压 Qwen Image（27B）和 FLUX.2 dev。值得注意的是，这也是 Artificial Analysis 榜单前十中唯一的开源模型。 但消息一出，有人说最强一代开源文生图模型“实至名归”，却也有人直接骂“生成质量一坨”。Artificial Analysis 可不是随便哪里冒出来的野生榜单，盲测 Arena 里都是用户实时投票打出来的结果。 两极分化的评价让我们感到好奇。因此我们花了几天时间，从 Reddit 到 GitHub，从架构解析到上手实测地拆解了一遍。 HiDream-O1-Image 更像是一个技术方向正确的探路者，无法也不必承担杀死比赛的期待。 作为开源第一，它和目前的行业第一 GPT Image 2 之间还有着不小的差距。这背后是 8B 参数开源版本同样明显的亮点和问题，但它却已然勾勒出了，未来 200B＋参数 Pro 版本宏伟的可能性。 Artificial Analysis榜单前十只有HiDream 8B作为开源模型入围 01  UiT 架构创新 在 HiDream-O1-Image 之前，主流文生图模型都选择了一条“拼盘”路线。VAE 负责压缩图像，T5/CLIP 负责理解文本，DiT 负责生成。三件套各司其职，这种方案不可避免的后果就是信息损耗，每一次跨模块的传递，都会丢失细节。 而 HiDream-O1-Image 此番登顶 Artificial Analysis，其核心创新 UiT 架构正是瞄准了这一行业短板。 HiDream 采用的 UiT 架构，把像素、文本、任务条件全部映射到了同一个 token space 进行端到端处理。

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng News - In May 2026, Zhixiang Future open-sourced the text-to-image model HiDream-O1-Image (8B), which directly topped the Artificial Analysis open-source model global rankings, with an Elo score of 1187 surpassing Qwen Image (27B) and FLUX.2 dev. Notably, it is also the only open-source model in the top 10 of Artificial Analysis. However, upon the announcement, some hailed it as "deservedly the strongest open-source text-to-image model," while others directly cursed its "generation quality as trash." Artificial Analysis is not some random wild ranking; its blind test Arena results come from real-time user votes. The polarized reviews piqued our curiosity. So we spent several days dissecting it, from Reddit to GitHub, from architectural analysis to hands-on testing. HiDream-O1-Image is more of a pathfinder with the right technical direction, unable and unnecessary to bear the expectation of killing the competition. As the open-source leader, it still has a significant gap from the current industry leader GPT Image 2. Behind this are distinct strengths and issues in the open-source 8B parameter version, yet it has already outlined the grand possibilities of the future 200B+ parameter Pro version.
excerpt_i18n.es: En mayo de 2026, Zhixiang Future lanzó como código abierto el modelo de texto a imagen HiDream-O1-Image (8B), alcanzando directamente el primer puesto mundial en modelos de código abierto de Artificial Analysis, con una puntuación Elo de 1187 superando a Qwen Image (27B) y FLUX.2 dev. Cabe destacar que también es el único modelo de código abierto entre los diez primeros de la clasificación de Artificial Analysis. Pero tan pronto como se conoció la noticia, algunos dijeron que el mejor modelo de código abierto de generación de texto a imagen era merecedor del título, mientras que otros lo criticaron directamente diciendo que la calidad de generación es una porquería.

excerpt_i18n.en: Leifeng.com reports that the battle in AI is increasingly revealing its ruthless side as it nears real-world application. Measured gains or losses of a few points on benchmarks are becoming less meaningful, replaced by the hard-nosed return on investment. How can agents truly understand business operations? How can model intelligence unlock greater value in business scenarios? These have become the core issues of the current competitive phase. And databases are also being pushed to center stage. In the past, their role was simple—essentially a long-term, secure, queryable data storage system. For instance, when users shop on Taobao, completing actions like placing orders, making payments, requesting refunds, or tracking logistics, the most basic requirement is that these records must not be lost or erroneous, must be queryable, and must support the high-concurrency pressure of hundreds of millions of people placing orders simultaneously during peak periods. That was the core capability of databases in the mobile internet era—revolving around storage and querying, giving rise to needs for consistency, concurrency handling, and disaster recovery. But as agents delve deeper into production scenarios, they have naturally become new users of databases. Agents need real-time access to various structured and unstructured data. The database has transformed from a storage module serving humans writing SQL to query data into the memory system of agents. This new role means that beyond storage, databases must also support RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and real-time data-stream-driven AI. In RAG scenarios, AI answers questions by retrieving information from the database and generating responses—without a database, there would be no retrieval.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cuanto más cerca está la competencia de la IA de la implementación práctica, más cruel se vuelve. La importancia de ganar o perder unos pocos puntos en los benchmarks se está volviendo limitada; en su lugar, lo que importa es la relación entre la inversión y el rendimiento reales. Cómo los agentes pueden comprender verdaderamente los negocios y cómo la inteligencia de los modelos puede liberar mayor valor en el ámbito empresarial se han convertido en las cuestiones centrales de esta fase de competencia. Y junto con esto, las bases de datos también están siendo llevadas al centro del escenario. En el pasado, su papel era simple: esencialmente un sistema de almacenamiento de datos a largo plazo, seguro y consultable. Por ejemplo, cuando un usuario compra en Taobao y realiza una serie de operaciones como realizar un pedido, pagar, solicitar un reembolso y rastrear la logística, la necesidad más básica es que estos registros estén disponibles.
